messages.subject: Project Falcon - SPA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Please find attached our mark-up of the share purchase agreement (v2, redline against your first draft). The principal changes reflect our diligence findings:

- escrow period increased to 24 months;
- de minimis raised to £15,000;
- warranty claim period extended to 24 months and the tax claim period to 7 years;
- a specific indemnity for the HMRC R&D enquiry (in the tax schedule); and
- tightened customer and onerous-contract warranties.

The redline is attached. We've left the general liability cap at the consideration. Look forward to your comments.

Kind regards
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. Most of this is workable. Our clients will not agree 24 months' escrow - we'll come back at 18, and may land at 21. The de minimis we'll accept at £12,500. We're content with the R&D indemnity in principle subject to wording. Our counter (v3) will follow next week.

Jonathan
